The latest Academy Award for Best Animated Short Film was won by "War Is Over! Inspired by the Music of John & Yoko" at the 96th Oscars in 2024 [d5][d3]. The film was directed by Dave Mullins and produced by Brad Booker, marking the first Oscar win for both filmmakers [d5]. Set to John Lennon and Yoko Ono's anti-war song "Happy Xmas (War Is Over)," the animated short follows two soldiers in World War I playing a chess game via carrier pigeon, unaware they are on opposing sides [d5]. Some older sources listed earlier winners such as Hair Love (2019) [d2] or The Windshield Wiper (2022) [d7] as the most recent, but these have been superseded by the 2024 result confirmed by multiple sources [d3][d5][d6].
